env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^4 7 9$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arenafixed

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"logos/arena"
)

func main() {
	var buf [4]byte
	r := arena.OpenFixed(buf[:])
	values := arena.Make[byte](r, 2)
	values[0] = 7
	values = arena.Append(r, values, byte(8), byte(9))
	fmt.Println(arena.FixedUsed(r), buf[0], buf[3])
}
